name: Shattered Halberd
descriptionTemplate: Deal [Damage:Arg1] DMG and gain an equal amount of {Counter}, enjoying a 50% {Tentacle DMG} bonus.
lore:
I've given up everything as a human! I shall return to the embrace of ocean!
But why has my transformation failed?
Is it the mockery of fate? Or my own foolishness?
Madness-driven Caecus clutched the broken trident, attempting to sink into the sea.
As long as he could return and be accepted, he would clear any obstacle in his path.
